verdict.rationale: vLLM is an API-first inference engine, and the evidence documents no separate UI. Its capabilities are exposed through an OpenAI-compatible API server plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC, launched via CLI or the official Docker image. Tool calling (including tool_choice options), structured outputs, reasoning fields and streaming are all documented as API features. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or audit of API/UI parity (no UI is documented to compare against), independent hands-on corroboration that every feature is reachable over the API, and machine-readable docs (llms.txt returns 404).
